Minutes of a Regular Meeting of the City Council of
Austin Texas July 20th 1899.
Hon H.M. Maddox, President of the Council, Presiding. Roll Called Present, Aldermen Brady,
Crooker, Grove, Haynes, Horton, Huhn, Maddox, McLemone, Miller, Morris, Nitschkte, Powell,
Redd, Rosengren, Shelley, Stumpff, and Walke. 17.
Absent: Aldermen Beaty, Belvin, Fehr, Fischer and Ziller. 5.
Minutes adopted On Motion the minutes were approved, as recorded, without reading.
Reports of Standing Committees
Rept of Police
Comm" Alderman Powell for the Police Committee, to whom was referred the reports of the
City Marshal, for the month of January 1899, presented a report stating that, the reports
have been examined and found correct. Report adopted, and ordered filed.
Alderman Fehr entered the Council Chamber.
Alderman Shelley moved that Mr Jno. B. Taylor, be allowed to withdraw his petition (asking
payment of claim for household goods destroyed) for correction, which motion prevailed.
New Business
Ord. Appt $180"
to build Bridge By Alderman Morris An Ordinance appropriating the sum of $180" Mo to place
on 2d to build a bridge at the intersection of N. 2d & Congress Avenue. reading Lost. The
Ordinance was read the first time and a motion made to suspend the rules and place the
Ordinance on the second reading, which motion was lost by the following Vote: Yeas
Aldermen Brady, Crooker, Fehr, Haynes, Horton, Huhn, Maddox, McLemone, Morris, Powell,
Rosengren, Stumpff. 12.
Nays Aldermen Grove, Miller, Nitschkte, Redd, Shelley & Walke 6.
Aldermen Beaty and Belvin entered the Council Chamber. Ord. Appt $1600" for Stow Culvert.
By Alderman Powell an Ordinance appropriating the sum of $1600." Mo to place on 2d to
build a stone arch Culvert or steel bridge on N. 6th & Nueces Sts reading Lost over little
shoal Creek. The ordinance was read, the first time, and a motion made to suspend the
rules, and place the ordinance, on its second reading, which motion was lost by the
following Vote: Yeas, Aldermen, Belvin, Crooker, Haynes, Horton, Huhn, Maddox, McLemone,
Miller, Morris, Nitschkte, Powell, Rosengren, & Stumpff. 13.
Nays Aldermen Beaty, Brady, Fehr, Grove, Redd, Shelley, and Walke. 7. Ord. Appt $1520" for
Hose Wagons Hose By Alderman Stumpff, an: Ordinance appropriating the sum of $1520" Mo 1 &
2 to purchase Hose wagons for Washington Hose Co No1, and East Austin Passed. Hose Co. No
2, and for 1000 feet of Fire Hose. The ordinance was passed under suspension of the rules
by the following Vote: Yeas Aldermen Beaty, Belvin, Brady, Crooker, Fehr, Fischer, Grove,
Haynes, Horton, Huhn, Maddox, McLemone, Miller, Morris, Nilschkte, Powell, Redd,
Rosengren, Shelley, Stumpff and Walke. 21. Nays None.
Ord. Appt $550"
Reimburse Hose By Alderman Stumpff, An Ordinance appropriating the sum of $550 " Co No 5 &
6 to reimburse South Austin Hose Co. No 6, and North Austin Hose Co No 6, Passed. for
amount paid out by them for Hose wagons.
The Ordinance was passed under suspension of the rules by the following Vote:

129

Yeas Aldermen, Beaty, Belvin, Brady, Crocths, Fehl, Fiscwl, Grove, Haynes, Horton, Huhn,
Maddox, McLenord, Miller, Morris, Nitschke, Powell, Ridd, Rosingreu, Stelly, Stumiff, and
Walther. 21. Nays None.

Alderman Zilter, entred the Council Chamber.

Ord. Appg $900 By Alderman Stumiff, An Ordinance appropriating the sum of $900 for Sal +
Reld to pay the salary of driver of North Austin Hose Co No 6. and for food Hose Co No 6.
and repairs for said Company. The Ordinance was read first time amended to read and on
motion the rule was suspended, and the Ordinance placed for $750 per upon its second
reading by the following Vote: passed as amended Yeas, Aldermen, Beaty, Belvin, Brady,
Crocths, Fehl, Haynes, Huhn, Maddox, McLenord, Miller, Morris, Powell, Ridd, Rosingreu,
Shelley, Stumiff, Walther and Zilter. 15.
Nays. Aldermen, Hischer, Grove, Horton, and Nitschke. 4.
The Ordinance was read the second time, Alderman Morris moved to amend the Ordinance by
striking out $900 wherever it occurs in the Ordinance and inserting in lieu thereof $750,
and to amend the Caption and Sec. 1. of the same, by adding to each the words "for the
month of February 1899". The amendments were adopted and the Ordinance as amended was
passed under a suspension of the rule by the following Vote: Yeas, Aldermen, Beaty,
Belvin, Brady, Crocths, Fehl, Hischer, Grove, Haynes, Horton, Huhn, Maddox, McLenord,
Miller, Morris, Nitschke, Powell, Ridd, Rosingreu, Stelly, Stumiff, Walther and Zilter.
22. Nays None.

Mo. to place driver Alderman Stumiff moved that the City Clerk, be instructed to of Hose
Co No 6. on place the driver of North Austin Hose Co No 6. on the roll, regularly the
Payroll & to pay at a salary of $50 per month and, that the allowance for food and for
food & monthly repairs for said Company be fixed at $25 per month, which motion passed.
prevailed. Alderman McLenord moved that a Committee of 3 be Mo for Com of 3 appointed by
the chair to consult with the owners and managers of to Consult drainge the Sewer Co. in
regard to connecting the drainage from the alley w/ Driskill Hotel with West of the
Driskill Hotel with said Sewer, which motion prevailed.
Ord. auth. redem- By Alderman Morris, An Ordinance authorizing the redemption of ption of
real estate Real Estate heretofore sold for taxes, under judgment of the Dist Sold for
Taxes Court and bid in by the City of Austin. The Ordinance was passed. passed under
suspension of the rules by the following Vote; Yeas Aldermen, Beaty, Belvin, Brady,
Crocths, Fehl, Hischer, Grove, Haynes, Horton, Huhn, Maddox, McLenord, Miller, Morris,
Nitschke, Powell, Ridd, Rosingreu, Stelly, Stumiff, and Zilter. 21.
Nays Aldermen, Walther. 1.

From resolution The Chair announced the following as the Committee provided In Com of 3
for in the resolution of Alderman McLenord, Viz: Aldermen, McLenord, Rosingreu, and
Belvin.
Alderman Norton offered the following resolution which was unanimously adopted.

Austin Texas, July 20th 1899.
[illegible] Resolved by the Mayor and the City Council of Austin, assembled

invitation to that we as a body representative of the City of Austin extend a K of P to
hold in cordial invitation to the Grand Lodge of Knights of Pythias. of G. T. in year in
of the State of Texas, to hold their annual session in the City of Austin this City passed

An from Gormuller invitation from Governor Sayers to attend a reception at the Sayers to

Geo. B. Johnson
